title: Add Shop Management System with Open/Close Toggle

requirements.text: Add a shop status toggle switch at the top of the Admin Dashboard that allows admins to manually open or close the shop

quotes: Add a clear 'Shop Status' toggle switch at the top of the Admin Dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: Toggle switch is prominently displayed at the top of the Admin Dashboard page
Toggle shows clear visual distinction between ON (Open) and OFF (Closed) states
Toggle state persists after page refresh
Toggle is only accessible to authenticated admin users

requirements.text: Store shop open/closed status in the backend and provide methods to get and update the status

quotes: When the toggle is OFF (Closed), the app should prevent any new orders

acceptanceCriteria: Backend maintains a boolean shopOpen state variable
Provides a query method to retrieve current shop status
Provides an update method for admins to change shop status
Update method is restricted to admin users only

requirements.text: Prevent customers from placing new orders when the shop is closed

quotes: When the toggle is OFF (Closed), the app should prevent any new orders

acceptanceCriteria: Order placement method checks shop status before accepting orders
Returns an error message when attempting to place orders while shop is closed
Existing orders are not affected by shop status changes

requirements.text: Display a full-width notice banner on the home screen when the shop is closed with the text 'Namaste! MBG Store is currently Closed. We are not accepting orders right now. We will open again at 8:00 AM. Thank you for your patience!' using a calm background color (soft orange or grey)

quotes: When the shop is closed, show a high-quality, full-width Notice Banner on the home screen
Banner Text: 'Namaste! MBG Store is currently Closed. We are not accepting orders right now. We will open again at 8:00 AM. Thank you for your patience!'
Design: Use a calm background color (like soft orange or grey)

acceptanceCriteria: Banner appears at the top of the home screen when shop is closed
Banner displays the exact text specified
Banner uses a soft orange or grey background color
Banner is full-width and professionally styled
Banner disappears when shop is open

requirements.text: Disable 'Add to Cart' and 'Checkout' buttons across the entire app when the shop is closed

quotes: disable the 'Add to Cart' and 'Checkout' buttons across the entire app

acceptanceCriteria: All 'Add to Cart' buttons in ProductCard components are disabled when shop is closed
Checkout button in CartDrawer is disabled when shop is closed
Disabled buttons show visual indication (greyed out or similar)
Buttons function normally when shop is open

requirements.text: Add a small colored dot indicator next to the store name in the header showing green when open and red when closed

quotes: Add a small 'Open' (Green Dot) or 'Closed' (Red Dot) indicator next to the store name on the header so customers can see the status instantly from any page

acceptanceCriteria: Green dot appears next to store name when shop is open
Red dot appears next to store name when shop is closed
Indicator is visible on all pages with the header
Dot has a small, unobtrusive size but is clearly visible
Status updates in real-time when shop status changes

requirements.text: Show a popup notification during checkout with the message 'Sorry, the store just closed. Please place your order when we reopen!' if the shop closes while a customer has items in their cart

quotes: If a customer already has items in their cart and the shop closes, show a popup during checkout saying: 'Sorry, the store just closed. Please place your order when we reopen!'

acceptanceCriteria: Popup appears on the checkout page if shop status changes to closed
Popup displays the exact message specified
Popup prevents order submission until dismissed
User can dismiss the popup and return to cart or home
Popup does not appear if shop was already closed when user navigated to checkout

constraints: Shop status control must be restricted to admin users only
Do not modify the existing authentication system or AdminGuard component
Maintain compatibility with existing order management and cart functionality
Preserve the current header layout and styling conventions
nonGoals: Automatic scheduling of shop open/close times
Notification system to alert customers when shop reopens
Partial shop closure (closing specific categories or products)
Historical tracking of shop open/close events
